items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 1.2% in 1985 to 2.0% in 2025 across 686 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

72 of 686 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 57 for salt or chloride; 86 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 686 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 27 of 27 high-need ones have none.
